editorial:
Imagine being a tough guy who spent his whole life doing the dirty work for a mob boss, only to find out your brain is starting to fail you. That is exactly where you find our main character, an old ex-boxer who is dealing with a scary medical diagnosis. He wants to make things right with his kids and leave something good behind for his grandson before it is too late. The vibe is a mix of a gritty crime story and a sad family drama, making you really root for a man who has done some pretty bad things in his time.

You will love the acting here because the lead makes you feel every bit of his struggle. The action is punchy and the mystery keeps you guessing, though some parts of the story move a bit slow. If you enjoy stories about redemption and old-school gangsters, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV to see all the gritty detail. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: In the final act, the main character faces off against his former boss one last time to protect his family. He manages to take down the criminals who tried to keep him trapped in the underworld. After the violence ends, he finds a moment of peace with his children. He accepts his illness but feels okay knowing his grandson is safe and his past sins are finally washed away.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about tough guys with a heart of gold.
